name: Reminders
description: Emails each reminder the app keeps once, when it's due, with no one opening the app, at times in the Developer's own time zone.
fits: Add it when the app has to email people at a set time, such as reminding everyone who signed up the day before a run. Not for an email on a timetable, such as a rota every Monday.
edits: In wrangler.jsonc, add `{ "name": "REMINDERS", "class_name": "Reminders" }` to `durable_objects`' bindings, adding `durable_objects` if there isn't one, and the Developer's time zone to `vars`, such as `"TIME_ZONE": "Europe/London"`.
Export the class from the Worker's main module (main in wrangler.jsonc): `export { Reminders } from "./reminders";` from src/server/index.ts, or `"./server/reminders"` from src/index.ts.
In worker-configuration.d.ts, add `REMINDERS: DurableObjectNamespace<import("./src/server/reminders").Reminders>;` and `TIME_ZONE: string;` to the __BaseEnv_Env interface.
Where the app keeps a reminder, import `reminders` and `instantAt` from `./reminders` (`./server/reminders` from src/index.ts) and use them as its notes say.
